verdict.rationale: ClickUp ships AI agents (Brain², Super Agents, build-your-own agent), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the MCP evidence covers only ClickUp's own MCP server, which lets external assistants like Claude reach into ClickUp. That is the server role, not the ability to plug outside MCP servers into ClickUp. Brain²'s connections to Google Drive, GitHub and Salesforce are described as native integrations, with no mention of attaching arbitrary MCP servers or using their tools.
